panels.description: Older Alex fits TJ's body together; one leg is missing. Keep the upper dock clear.
The granddaughter turns the damaged component over, revealing a maker's mark. Keep the upper lake background quiet.
The tanker becomes a dark speck across the lake. Keep the upper sky clear.
The component's amber indicator blinks beside an open public water terminal. Keep the upper terminal space clear.

items.speaker: GRANDDAUGHTER
items.text: How did you get this lake?

items.speaker: GRANDDAUGHTER
items.text: That mark’s on the old pumps.

items.speaker: GRANDDAUGHTER
items.text: Do you know who sent them?
